parameters.onTap: Runs when the reader activates the component. Leave it unset for a read-only item.
parameters.lead: Whether it is the screen's lead block, raised on the hard shadow.
parameters.padding: Sets the space between the frame and its content.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls it when it is a button.
parameters.debugLabel: Names the block in the keyline check’s findings; never drawn or spoken.
